shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
horizontal banded division of the field
human figure (A as sculpted body, B in relief profile)
justification: Both are grey stone surfaces worked in shallow relief with circular disc motifs and horizontal banding organising the field, which is the most concrete correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a bulky three-dimensional monolith with coarse, schematic, non-narrative motifs wrapped around a curved back, while B is a flat, finely finished wall panel with a naturalistic, horizontally ordered procession of an animal and an attendant beneath a regular rosette frieze.
